museum.location_exact_excerpt: 位于棂星门东、仪门正南。
museum.repair_and_dimensions_exact_excerpt: 2004年由崇明县人民政府投资修复，长10.7米，宽8.8米，高8米，建筑面积94平方米。
museum.historical_repair_exact_excerpt: 乾隆二十五年（1760年）由知县赵廷健修葺，见于清光绪《崇明学宫图》。
museum.historical_school_gate_exact_excerpt: 民国四年（1915年）为崇明县立初级中学校门。
museum.period_limit: The 1760 repair and 1915 school-gate use are historical records, not evidence of the modern facade or present function. The 2004 repair date does not establish a unique construction year or verify the complete 2004 or 2026 condition.
museum.measurement_limit: The text gives length and width without cardinal directions or wall, column, base or eave endpoints. Assigning 10.7 x 8.8 m to a local X/Y base is a model interpretation, not surveyed placement.

area_arithmetic_check.limit: The product is close to the rounded documented area. This arithmetic does not identify measurement endpoints or establish the physical plan or orientation.

photographic_scope.identity_limit: Ruxue Gate lies south of Yimen and east of Lingxing Gate in the museum text. A photograph captioned Yimen is a separate building and cannot establish Ruxue Gate roof ends, curtain, openings or columns.
photographic_scope.panorama_limit: Panorama and aerial references supply spatial context only. Buildings at image edges or in the background are not automatically assigned to Ruxue Gate.

implementation_reuse.scope: Reuse the basic modeling logic and supporting construction/export workflow, with independent Ruxue Gate base, wall, roof, height and parameterized opening dimensions.
